sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The module aims to introduce various technologies and key applications related to IoT for smart cities. The module introduces a general framework and structure of smart cities in terms of IoT technologies, platforms, and tools that are currently used in smart cities. Students will gain a solid knowledge of contextual understanding in the smart city domain and practical skills not only based on IoT but also closely related to smart city areas. The module also covers an understanding of the best practices in smart cities considering its use cases at the current stage.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Demonstrate a solid understanding of concepts, processes, and issues related to IoT for smart cities. B. Identify applications of IoT for smart cities that can help improve technical operations. C. Determine the appropriate use of IoT technologies, tools, and software to build smart cities.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching philosophy of the module follows very much the philosophy of Syntegrative Education. This has meant that the teaching delivery pattern, which follows more intensive block teaching, allows more meaningful contributions from a practical perspective. This philosophy is carried through also in terms of assessment, with a reduction in the use of exams and an increase in coursework, especially problem-based assessments that are project-focused. The delivery pattern provides space in the semester for students to concentrate on completing the assessments. The module will be delivered via lectures and supervised laboratory sessions, as well as private studies.
